This is a document evidence gap, not a demonstrated native production defect. Schema type acceptance and a verified boolean cannot demonstrate exact field consumption. findings.title: Closed schema and validator omit enum and digest-format guards
findings.detail: Unknown CAS outcome falls through to confirmed receipt and returns GenerationActivated; malformed approved hash passes schema. Both fields have only string/minLength constraints; the validator also lacks enum/pattern support. Add declared closed enums/formats plus recursive enforcement before oracle; fail closed without calls/mutation.
